rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a large blastocoel, thinned zona, visible ICM, and circumferential TE consistent with a good-quality expanded/full blastocyst; minor uncertainty between stage 3 vs 4 is reasonable from the image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, FSH, uterine factor, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and prior live birth with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well-structured, with conclusions tied to embryo quality and uterine factors; only minor limitation is somewhat broad probability framing without precise calibration.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unsupported add-ons; slight overinterpretation of morphology stage nuance prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer readiness, uterine evaluation, luteal support, and future-cycle planning with appropriate nuance for this case.
